titles: 15 Things We Did in the 1970s That Are No Longer Allowed Today
15 Everyday 1970s Habits That Would Shock Your Grandkids Today
15 Things Every 1970s Family Did That You Can't Do Anymore
description_intro:
These are the 1970s things that are no longer allowed today, and chances are you did every one of them without a second thought. Riding in the back of the pickup, chasing the mosquito fogging truck, lawn darts at the family picnic, walking Grandma right to the airport gate, and lighting up at thirty thousand feet.

Pour a cup of coffee and take a slow trip back to the days of full-service gas stations, ashtrays in every room, and being home when the streetlights came on. How did we ever survive?

Which ones did your family do? Tell us where you grew up in the comments. We read every one.
